author: Stephan Bechert
why: Clear Amboseli mountain profile with giraffe foreground and blue sky; distinctive African setting, although the summit lacks snow. Native dimensions unverified.

author: Sergey Pesterev
why: Classic Amboseli view with the snow-covered summit above clouds and savanna foreground; strongest recognisable mountain portrait. URL requests 3000px width; native dimensions unverified.

author: Vladan Raznatovic
why: Amboseli viewpoint with flowers and grassland providing colourful foreground depth; alternative to the dry-savanna composition. Native dimensions unverified.
